The expansion (P_w−P_u)h=−⟨h,w⟩(w−u)−⟨h,w−u⟩u gives operator norm at most 2‖w−u‖. Splitting P_wD(w)*−P_uD(u)* at P_wD(u)*, using projection contraction and isometry/linearity of the adjoint, gives (M₂+2M₁)‖w−u‖. The law difference at w uses r_μ−r_ν=m_μ−m_ν, then the point difference uses r_ν. With chord domination the two coefficients are 2M₁² on d_Q and 2(M₂+2M₁)R on c, including the outer factor 2 in G.
